knowledge_graph.description: Ola Electric Mobility Limited is an Indian electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Bengaluru. Founded in 2017 by Bhavish Aggarwal, the company designs and manufactures electric two-wheelers, including the Ola S1 in three variants named Ola S1 Air, Ola S1X and S1 Pro.

reviews.snippet: Very bad App experience. The rating of the driver gets automatically 5 stars. No option to change it. Even after finding the ride below par, nothing can be done. No option in the rude help, especially to inform that the auto number shown is different from the auto arrived. No option to give our feedback about the ride. Charges are more than the other similar Apps. Drivers are not polite, unclean vehicles.

reviews.snippet: I don't remember changing my payment option on the app. I have ended up paying both the driver and the Ola wallet dues! there's no support on this front too!! Edit: I realised the payment method changes when you use Ola Parcel. And later, when you try using the app for a ride, the payment option would have gotten updated. Such a petty bug. Uninstalling this rascaldom of an app until the fix!

I am extremely disappointed with the service. If riders are not willing to accept rides, I don’t understand why they are registering on the platform in the first place. I tried booking a ride multiple times, but the riders kept refusing or cancelling the requests. This was extremely inconvenient and resulted in me wasting several hours just trying to arrange a ride. The app should have a better system to ensure that riders who are actively available actually accept bookings.

Literally pathetic app. The driver claims to have accepted the ride and have picked me up, while in reality he is 10 minuted away. Even when I call him, he becomes unresponsive and doesn't pick up. He probably wants me to cancel the ride so he doesn't have to cancel it himself. It reduces my credibility and makes it harder for me to book. This has happened countless times. The drivers take advantage of this situation. Not to mention the sudden amount increase after accepting the ride.

If there were a negative rating option, I would give negative 5 stars. I booked the cab through Ola, and the fare shown at the time of booking was ₹458. However, after reaching the destination, the driver asked me to pay ₹600, saying that the Ola app is only used for booking and that the actual fare is ₹25/km. If drivers can charge a different amount from the fare shown in the app, then there is no point in using Ola. This is extremely disappointing and needs to be addressed.

Very concerning experience today. The auto that arrived had a different registration number from the one shown in the Ola app. My destination also appeared to have changed, and I was dropped at a different location. I felt unsafe because of the driver's behaviour and had to pay extra instead of the original amount. I’m also unable to give the driver a star rating. Passenger safety is seriously questionable. Ola needs to investigate such incidents and take strict action.

Ola has honestly become one of the most frustrating ride-booking applications to use. Booking a cab can take hours, and even after finally finding a driver, there’s no guarantee that the ride will actually happen. The worst part is when a driver accepts the booking and then cancels the ride after making you wait. You’re left repeating the same process again and again, wasting valuable time with absolutely no reliability.

There are almost never any bikerides found for the shorter routes, in the morning, resulting in me having to pay more for other services . The longer routes are still okay as bookings are accepted. Why could I not change my destination after starting the trip. Some work made me stop the trip halfway but I still paid for the full trip. Almost Rs 100 more. Such a waste of money. Last minute changes happen to the all of us.

I booked a ride for a place, it showed the same name till I was dropped to a different location 5 Kms away from it !! on top of it, there is no option to highlight it or reach out to the customer care. congratulations you've successfully created a system so that customers can't reach out to you; at least not through the easy ways !

My family and I have been using this app for about seven years now, and over the course of that duration, the quality has declined to ridiculous amounts. The final fare at the end of the ride is vastly different from the time you booked it. If you schedule a cab and there are no updates, they'll still charge cancellation fees, despite the issue being from their side. From the past 3 months, they haven't even booked a vehicle, the line just reaches the end painfully slow and with bad puns.

Nothing can be worse than this. No way to contact customer care (no chat option and no helpline). They have published a few FAQs and they think customers will face only those issues. For refunds, they issue coupons and they don't allow customers to apply the entire amount. For the remaining coupon balance, there is no way you will be able to find the new coupon code. There is no way to check coupon balance. They are treating the customers like beggars. Govt. must take an immediate action on Ola.

On clicking on a location link from other apps to start riding, it always selects it as the destination. If I want it as a starting point, there is no way I can switch. Copying and pasting the same address details to the starting point from the destination text box will go to a different location. Why can't we have a simple switch feature to swap destination and starting points? It's too much inconvenience if we are booking for another person.

Worst experience I've ever had. The fare was ₹40 when I booked the ride, but I was charged ₹87 after reaching my destination—more than double the original price. There was no heavy traffic, and the distance was only about 5 km. Such unexpected fare increases are unfair and misleading. Please be transparent with your pricing.

Terrible experience. The app is super glitchy while selecting the pickup and drop location itself. That's okay, somehow I got a ride. It showed 4 mins but actually 15 mins for the bike to come, and the OTP doesn't match, but it was showing my name correctly!! The guy won't start the bike also. Then another guy came, which seems to be the correct bike. Ola is unusable and glitchy, i chose ola this time because I had a parallel rapido booking for someone else. Please improve your product.

My experience with Ola has been extremely disappointing. After booking a ride, captains often take a long time to accept, and sometimes they cancel the ride as well. I end up waiting for a long time, which makes me late for work. This has happened multiple times and is extremely inconvenient. Ola seriously needs to improve its service and captain management.

Very poor customer service. I booked an outstation cab where the fare shown at booking was ₹3,560, but I was charged ₹3,903. Despite multiple complaints and follow-ups, I have only received ticket numbers and generic replies saying someone will contact me. No one has actually contacted me or provided a proper explanation. Ola is now claiming ₹3,903 was the agreed fare, which is not true. Extremely disappointing experience.

⭐ 1/5 Very poor app experience. We booked an Ola S1 Pro on Aug 16 with an estimated delivery of Aug 26. It’s now Sep 2nd, but the app still shows Aug 26 with no revised date or explanation. There’s no meaningful delivery tracking or update. The showroom also ignores calls and messages. After taking the booking, Ola should at least provide accurate status and basic communication. Extremely frustrating and disappointing.

Very disappointing experience. I booked an outstation ride a day in advance, but the driver never arrived and ignored my 7–8 calls. I was travelling with 3 senior citizen family members, and they had to wait with luggage and face unnecessary stress. I had to book another cab at the last minute, which cost me much more. If scheduled rides aren't reliable, what's the point of booking in advance? Very poor service.

I faced the same issue with Ola. I spent nearly 2 hours trying to book a ride, but no booking was confirmed. I even changed my pickup location to a nearby area and tried different options, but it still didn't work. It's very disappointing when you can't book a ride for a nearby location despite repeated attempts. Ola needs to improve its service and ensure better driver availability.👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻

product_info.title: Ola: Book Cab, Auto, Bike Taxi

about_this_app.snippet: Upgrade your life the OLA Way!Ever found yourself chasing Cabs, Auto Rickshaws or Bike Taxis? Or searching for a reliable parcel service? Welcome to your one-stop destination - the Ola App! With over 40 Million Trusted users across 200+ cities in India, OLA has become the Choice of the Nation. 🚗 Want to learn about our Services in OLA App?Let’s start with the A, B & C of Rides:🛺 A for Auto Rickshaw: Want Auto rides without the Fare drama ? No more “meter nahi chal raha” excuses. Hop in for quick and affordable city trips with Transparent fares where your pocket will thank you.Tuk Tuk Tuk Tuk 🛺 …… your OLA Auto is waiting for you.🛵 B for Bike Taxi: Need to be as quick as a bullet?Say hello to your little friend, Ola Bike Taxi! Slip through traffic jams like a pro ninja. Perfect for solo riders with places to be.Why wait? Zip, zap, zoom!🚗 C for Cab: Because You Deserve OptionsWhatever your need, we’ve got an OLA cab for that:🚗 OLA Mini: Quick, comfy & wallet-friendly.🚘 OLA Prime Sedan: Spacious sedans, perfect for longer rides where you can Netflix & Ride in comfort.🚙 OLA Prime Plus: A touch of luxury & Guaranteed no cancellations. Just you and your premium quality ride with Top notch drivers.🚐 OLA Prime SUV: Traveling squad-style for a trip? Get Spacious SUVs with ample room for your Family or Friends and their luggage.OLA Rental Cars: Need a flexible ride for a few hours? 🕒 Renting a car with Ola gives you the freedom to hire a car on your terms.
